rootCauseCorrection.foundBy: Stage 2 audit #468 (P2 finding) on PR #467's own merge commit 46313229fe951353788b9f5954a9f8a72e39d36c
rootCauseCorrection.priorWrongCounts: 454-D's original run (661/660/1, 704/703/1, 719/718/1) and PR #467's own correction/re-verification (719/718/1, claimed reproducible in both bash and PowerShell, 857/857/0 claimed unreproducible) were both wrong in the same way.
rootCauseCorrection.cause: Every prior reproduction ran on a Windows checkout with `core.autocrlf=true`, which rewrites this repository's LF-stored files to CRLF on checkout. tools/review-watch/stage2-report.test.mjs extracts two ```markdown fenced examples from docs/stage2-audit-contract.md § 2 with a \n-anchored regex (extractCanonicalSkeletonFence) at module load time. Against a CRLF checkout that regex matches zero fences instead of two, the module throws synchronously during import, and Node's test runner reports the entire 139-test file as one failing test instead of running any of its individual tests -- silently dropping 138 real tests and reporting a false single failure. This is not a shell-portability issue (PR #467's conclusion) and not a pre-existing, unrelated defect (454-D's conclusion) -- it is a local git line-ending configuration artifact that happened to reproduce identically across two separate investigations because both ran on the same machine.
rootCauseCorrection.verification: git cat-file -p <commit>:docs/stage2-audit-contract.md (reading the stored blob directly, unaffected by working-tree checkout settings) is 216-for-216 LF-only (0 CRLF) at every commit checked. `git -c core.autocrlf=false worktree add` against the same commits produces CRLF-free checkouts (confirmed byte-for-byte via a Node byte scan). Against those LF-correct checkouts, node --test reports 857/857/0 for three of the four command/shell combinations tested: glob-based bash, explicit-file-enumeration bash, and explicit-file-enumeration PowerShell -- at both the PR #459 merge commit and the PR #467 merge commit. The fourth combination, glob-based PowerShell, still fails outright (`Could not find '...\*.test.mjs'`) even against an LF-correct checkout -- that is a separate, still-live shell-portability gap (PowerShell never expands the literal glob for a native executable), not corrected or affected by the line-ending fix, and is not folded into the 857/857/0 agreement claim. This repository does not yet enforce LF checkouts (no .gitattributes, tracked as issue #470), so an ordinary core.autocrlf=true checkout will still reproduce the false 719/718/1 undercount.

shellPortabilityNote: The glob-based command (`tools/review-watch/*.test.mjs tools/orchestration/*.test.mjs`) is genuinely shell-dependent, independent of the line-ending issue above: a POSIX shell (bash) expands the glob into 14 explicit filenames before node ever sees it; PowerShell does not expand it for a native executable, so the identical literal command fails outright there (`Could not find '...\*.test.mjs'`, this Node version does not fall back to broader test discovery). This finding (from PR #467's correction) remains valid and is retained; only the *counts* PR #467 attributed to it were wrong -- once line endings are correct, both the glob form (in bash) and the explicit-enumeration form (in either shell) report the identical 857/857/0.
